display_name: Athanasius, one of the Forty of Sebaste

names.note: Read out of the list of the forty names in doxologia.ro's life for 9 martie: «Iar numele acestor patruzeci de Sfinți Mucenici sunt acestea: „Chirion, Candid, Domnos, … Meliton și Aglaie”».
Read out of the list of the forty names on saint.gr's page for the company, «Κατά τους Παρισινούς Κώδικες 1575 και 1476 τα ονόματα τους ήταν: … Αθανάσιος …», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro opens the life «Pe vremea împărăției necredinciosului împărat Liciniu (308-324)» and closes it «și-au dat sufletele lor Domnului … în ziua a noua a lunii martie, stăpânind Liciniu în Răsărit». The page gives no year, so the interval is the reign it prints.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 martie — «✝ Sfinții 40 de Mucenici din Sevastia»

attestations.note: doxologia keeps the forty under one line, «✝ Sfinții 40 de Mucenici din Sevastia»; the life names all forty, and this folder is one of them.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Σαράντα Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στη Σεβάστεια»

attestations.note: The page for the company enumerates the forty and gives the names «Κατά τους Παρισινούς Κώδικες 1575 και 1476», after the Paris codices 1575 and 1476; that list prints «δυο Γοργόνιοι», two Gorgonii, and adds that some codices carry names beyond the forty, «όπως αυτά των Αγίων Αειθάλα, άλλου Γοργονίου». It puts the arrest at Sebaste under the eparch Agricolas in the reign of Licinius, gives no year, and says the empress Pulcheria found the relics in 438 in the church of St Thyrsus. Their synaxis «ετελείτο στο αγιότατο Μαρτύριό τους πλησίον του Χαλκού Τετραπύλου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Purtătorilor de chinuri, cin­stiţi patruzeci de ostaşi ai lui Hristos, prin foc şi prin apă aţi trecut şi v-aţi arătat împreună locuitori cu îngerii. Cu care rugaţi-vă lui Hristos, pentru cei ce vă laudă pe voi cu credinţă. Slavă Celui Ce v-a dat vouă tă­rie; Slavă Celui Ce v-a încunu­nat pe voi; Slavă Celui Ce a dă­ruit prin voi tuturor tămăduiri!

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor 40 de Mucenici din Sevastia, glasul 1

english.text: Bearers of torments, honoured forty soldiers of Christ, you passed through fire and through water and were shown to be fellow-dwellers with the angels. With them pray to Christ for those who praise you in faith. Glory to him who gave you strength; glory to him who crowned you; glory to him who through you has granted healing to all.

hymns.text: Toată oştirea lumii pără­sind-o, de Stăpânul Cel din ce­ruri v-aţi lipit, purtătorilor de biruinţă ai Domnului, sfinţilor patruzeci de mucenici. Că, prin foc şi prin apă trecând, fericiţilor, după vrednicie aţi primit mărire din ceruri şi mulţime de cununi.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfinţilor 40 de Mucenici din Sevastia, glasul 6, podobie «Împlinind rânduiala...»

english.text: Leaving behind the whole army of the world, you clung to the Master who is in heaven, victory-bearers of the Lord, holy forty martyrs. For having passed through fire and through water, blessed ones, you worthily received glory out of heaven and a multitude of crowns.

hymns.text: Θείω Πνεύματι, συγκροτηθέντες, δῆμος ὤφθητε, τροπαιοφόρος, Ἀθλοφόροι Χριστοῦ Τεσσαράκοντα, διὰ πυρὸς γὰρ καὶ ὕδατος ἔνδοξοι, δοκιμασθέντες λαμπρῶς ἐδοξάσθητε. Ἀλλ' αἰτήσασθε, Τριάδα τὴν ὑπερούσιον, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως, on the page of Άγιοι Σαράντα Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στη Σεβάστεια. The page prints two further apolytikia, a second kontakion, a megalynarion, an oikos and a kathisma for the company; the first apolytikion and the first kontakion are the ones taken, and all of them name the Τεσσαράκοντα and are the company's own service.

english.text: Drawn up together by the divine Spirit, you were shown to be a trophy-bearing company, forty victory-bearers of Christ; for having been tried by fire and by water, glorious ones, you were brightly glorified. Ask therefore of the Trinity beyond being that great mercy be granted to us.

hymns.text: Συντεταγμένοι εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ στερρότητι μαρτυρικῶς τὸν δυσμενῆ ἐθριαμβεύσατε, Τεσσαράκοντα γενναῖοι Χριστοῦ ὁπλῖται· Ἀλλ’ ὡς σύμμορφοι ἐν ἄθλοις καὶ ἐν χάριτι, Ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰρήνῃ συντηρήσατε τοὺς κραυγάζοντας, χαίροις ἅγιον σύνταγμα.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, on the same page, which prints a second kontakion in Ἦχος πλ. β’ as well.

english.text: Ranged together in piety and in steadfastness, you triumphed over the enemy as martyrs, brave forty soldiers of Christ. As you are of one form in your contests and in grace, keep in love and in peace those who cry to you: hail, holy regiment.
